messages:
morgan: Heads-up — I'm updating dedicated provisioning docs for autoscale YAML migration (reserved -> dedicated). Found an edge-case about tenant isolation labels that breaks the terraform example. Link to PR: <https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/821>

jamie: on it. can you paste the minimal repro? I want to include a short example in the handbook.

morgan: repro: when tenant label 'isolation: strict' is present, the autoscaler ignores reserved_pool selector. snippet:
```yaml
autoscale:
  policy: target_utilization
  target: 0.7
  reserved_pool_selector:
    region: us-west-2
  tenant_labels:
    isolation: strict
```
Observed behavior: provisioning flow uses default pool instead of dedicated reserved pool.

ara: that's a runtime fallback — we added a safety check that rejects strict isolation + reserved selectors unless allowRestrictedPools=true. Docs should call out the flag and show the sdk patch.

morgan: exactly. proposal: docs PR should add (1) explicit note about allowRestrictedPools, (2) quick SDK snippet to set it, (3) migration checklist entry to run `redwood migrate-pools --dry-run`.

lex: small nit: wording for SLA page — say 'strict isolation' implies data processed only on dedicated pools; don't promise cross-region failover without repl config. also add a link to the isolation explainer: <https://internal.redwood.com/isolation-runbook>

jamie: I can push wording + example. which SDK snippet? python or go?

morgan: python + terraform. python snippet:
```python
from redwood import DedicatedClient
c = DedicatedClient()
c.update_pool_config(
  pool_id='rp-1234',
  allow_restricted_pools=True,
  autoscale={'policy':'target_utilization','target':0.7}
)
```

jamie: thx. I'll add the terraform patch too and a short migration checklist step. I'll also fix the broken internal link (was pointing to /docs/isolation -> needs /runbooks/isolation).

docbot: PR 821 assigned to @jamie, will auto-close when merged. :white_check_mark:

sre-bot: FYI: created incident stub INC-2023-77 to track any post-rollout capacity regressions. tag me if you want a postmortem template.

morgan: perfect — pushing an update to PR in 15m. ping if you want me to split python vs terraform examples.

jamie: sounds good, thanks :thumbsup:
